data.gender_notes: Abra is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Abra comes from the root word 'avar' meaning father. The suffix 'ra' is added, which means 'many' or 'multitude'. In the Bible, Abram, whose name was later changed to Abraham, is considered the father of many nations. The name Abra carries the meaning “Father of a multitude” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Abra usually hope their child will grow to embody father of a multitude and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_greek.name: Άβρα
in_greek.meaning: Το Άβρα σημαίνει πατήρ ή πολλοί πατέρες
in_greek.long_meaning: Το Άβρα είναι ελληνική μορφή του ονόματος Αβραάμ, που σημαίνει πατήρ ή πολλοί πατέρες. Το όνομα προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή λέξη 'אבר', που σημαίνει πατήρ, και είναι σύμβολο της πνευματικής πατρότητας του Αβραάμ στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας.
